imports.title: Import a bank statement
imports.intro: Import a CSV or OFX file exported by your bank. The file is read on this server and goes nowhere else. Importing the same file twice adds nothing.
imports.noAccount: No active account yet. Add an account before importing.

imports.hasHeader: The first row contains column names
imports.sampleHeading: How the first rows will be read
imports.ceilingWarning: {label} ({date}) exceeds the deposit ceiling by {excess}: check it, or mark it as interest.
imports.archivedWarning: This account is archived: the movements are imported anyway because they already happened.
imports.accountRequired: Choose the account to import into.
imports.fileTooLarge: This file is larger than {max} MB.
imports.mappingNeeded: The columns could not be guessed. Fill in the CSV columns below, then preview again.
imports.nothingToImport: Nothing to import: every row is already in this account.
imports.fixProblems: Fix the rows below or the mapping, then preview again. Nothing is imported while a row is invalid.
